defects: Gold fixes a single (arbitrary but given) immersion φ as an explicit parameter with hypothesis `IsImmersionOfComplement F J J' n φ`, and the iff `CMDiff n f ↔ Continuous f ∧ CMDiff n (φ ∘ f)` is stated per-φ (so the backward direction only needs ONE such immersion, i.e. an existential-strength hypothesis when aggregated over all valid φ). The produced statement instead embeds a universal quantifier over ALL immersions g inside the RHS of the iff (`∀ g, IsImmersion g → ContMDiff (g ∘ f)`), making the backward direction require the composition property to hold for every immersion simultaneously — a materially different (and strictly weaker/different) proposition, not a restatement of gold.

Produced uses the plain `IsImmersion` predicate instead of gold's more specific `IsImmersionOfComplement` (which carries an explicit complement space F), dropping/altering the technical 'admits a complement' hypothesis on the immersion that the theorem in gold relies on.

Because the immersion is universally quantified in the produced statement, instantiating at a trivial immersion such as the identity map M' → M' collapses `ContMDiff I I'' n (g ∘ f)` to `ContMDiff I I' n f` itself, making the backward direction of the produced iff nearly tautological/circular and not capturing the nontrivial theorem content expressed in gold.

The 'further manifold' N' in gold is a fixed target of the given immersion φ, whereas in produced it is universally quantified (∀ M''), changing the logical role of the further manifold from a fixed given object to an arbitrarily-ranging one.
